authoritative_for: Platter owns its canonical SQLite library: captured inputs, preparation runs, immutable content artifacts, explicit job eligibility, frozen editions, recorded delivery outcomes, settings and maintenance holds. Editions share one model; retained-material selection is an operation. Platter also owns disposable Ashby board files under the runtime root, shared by preparation and preview for less than 14 days.

The product owns its schema-two Clockwork schedule definition and declares halt-until-approved. Clockwork owns failure-policy enforcement and retained scheduling incidents; product domain recovery remains separate.
not_authoritative_for: Cast owns discovery records. Annals retains Vita career material. Employer endpoints supply posting text. Nucleus owns execution. Email and Resend own submission acceptance. Gmail owns final receipt. Clockwork owns scheduled activation, durable scheduling halts, explicit continuation, incident notification and runtime process history.

covers: All Platter initialization, preparation, explicit regeneration, authorized daily and URL-selected preparation and delivery, ordinary and retained-material edition selection, explicit send, eligibility, export, local status, readiness, product-owned schedule-definition generation, migration and maintained installation outcomes.
excludes: Help/version, Clockwork activation management, automatic application submission, employer contact, source-library writes and final inbox delivery observation.

shared_access_and_trust: The current-user CLI operates private state. New Platter jobs use captured career reads and draft submission only, with workspace, shell and web disabled. Weaver owns project research and prose. Historical jobs retain their original access policy. Installer selection establishes no send authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Original and fixed project templates, captured career/posting inputs, Weaver requests and documents, packet artifacts, PDFs and editions remain private. Weaver and Nucleus retain source reads separately. Authorized sends disclose frozen message and attachments through Email.
Clockwork incident notification discloses bounded operational metadata to the fixed Email recipient. Product content and private failure output are not copied into the notification.

CLI dispatch separately attempts a metadata-only Chancery usage append (system, command, optional Codex thread and observation time). Recording errors preserve product results; no arguments or output are retained. Registration is a separate --register-usage installation step.
compatibility_and_retirement: Preparation contract 12 captures weaver_projects_v1 and uses Weaver contract 2 for project bullets, then platter/draft/2 for brief and Jackson. Installation contract 9 migrates schemas one through five to schema six without changing historical inputs, requests, artifacts or workflows.
operational_limits: Each edition contains up to three new ready packets; run-ad-hoc selects exactly one. There is no candidate or token budget. Jobs use gpt-5.6-sol at max effort. Run commands need applicable send authorization and do not resend accepted or uncertain editions. Activation is managed separately through Clockwork; stored 09:00 fields do not schedule work. Check source, runtime and rendering readiness separately.
